metadata.description: Official Adobe Experience Manager Forms Skills for AI Agents

plugins.name: adaptive-forms-authoring
plugins.description: Build, edit, and integrate AEM Adaptive Forms through conversation — analyze requirements, scaffold forms, add rules and functions, manage APIs, and sync with Edge Delivery Services.

plugins.name: forms-auto-optimisation
plugins.description: Automatically detect and fix runtime errors and API failures in AEM Adaptive Forms — diagnoses journey errors, classifies root causes, and applies fixes to backend Java code.

plugins.name: optel-query
plugins.description: Query and analyze AEM Operational Telemetry (RUM) data — build structured queries for page views, clicks, errors, Core Web Vitals, and form events, then execute them via the bundled optel-query.jsh script.
